Perfect — thanks, Alex. I’ll send a 15-minute invite for Wed 9/23 10:30 PT and include a short pre-read with the Dedicated minimums + Private retention summary.

Quick answers now so you have them:
- Dedicated baseline: typically reserved capacity starts at the equivalent of 1-2 A10 GPUs (configurable) for a single workload; we size based on peak TPS and tail-latency targets — Rafael and I can scope after a short workload survey.
- Private retention/audit: default logs retained 90 days, extended retention and SOC2 audit logs are available as an add-on — we can include specific retention SLAs in the SOW.

Invite and pre-read coming in a sec. Looking forward to the sync.

Best,
